title: Ahle Aza me sibte payambar ka hai matam
body:
AHL-E-AZA ME SIBT-E-PAYAMBAR KA HAI MATAM
ZEHRA KE PISAR WARIS-E-HYDER KA HAI MATAM
Ek kafira ne zehr-e-sitam tha pila diya
Masmoom Ibn-e-Saqie kausar ka hai matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Tukde dil-o-jigar ke gire farsh-e-khaak par
Qasim yateem hogaye Shabbar ka hai matam
Ahl-e-haram bhi rote hain aur khaak udate hain
Kya bekaso ke monis-o-yawar ka hai matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ye roke kehti hai bhai ki laash par
Mazloom-e-Karbala ke baradar ka hai matam
Dushman ke teer laash pe chalte hain haye haye
Rooh-e-Batool roti hai dilbar ka hai matam
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehlu me jab nawase ko madfan na mil saka
Larzaa’n nabi ki qabr hai Shabbar ka hai matam
Qasim bhi sogwaar hai karta hai aah-o-gham
Sab mominon ke hadi-o-rehbar ka hai matam
